_overrides.source: On the third silence it says "Sesinizi alamadığım için görüşmeyi sonlandırıyorum." and ends the call. No main menu in this case.
on the angry caller it was three calming replies, not two.
How often: **once per calendar year** (Kerem, 7 Oct).
